title: 水庫異重流排砂
summary: 本課以以密度差潛入沉降與底孔捕捉解析異重流為主線，先用懸浮濃度與混合密度與約化重力與浮力界定水力與構造條件，再將沉降時間與粒徑、底孔捕捉與排出連結到底流質量帳與殘留。均勻兩層與稀懸浮算例只呈現尺度，實際異重流受分層地形紊混與粒徑演變控制。 每單元以原創算例、量測與失效辨識共同檢查推論。
summaryEn: This course develops analyzing density currents through plunging settling and low-outlet capture through Suspension concentration and mixture density and Reduced gravity and buoyancy, then connects Settling time and particle size and Low-outlet capture and export to Current mass budget and residual storage. Uniform two-layer dilute-suspension examples illustrate scales; real currents depend on stratification topography mixing and grain-size evolution. Each unit combines original calculation, measurement and failure diagnosis to test the inference.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 整合算例輸入全為教學假設，先檢查懸浮濃度與混合密度：rhoWater=1000 kg/m3; rhoSediment=2650 kg/m3; volumeFraction=0.01; rhoMix=(1-0.01)*1000+0.01*2650=1016.5 kg/m3；再獨立檢查約化重力與浮力：g=9.81 m/s2; currentDensity=1016.5 kg/m3; ambientDensity=1000 kg/m3; reducedG=9.81*(1016.5-1000)/1000=0.161865 m/s2。敏感度：水與顆粒密度不變時，體積濃度由0.005增至0.010使密度差與約化重力加倍；固定流深下重力速度尺度增加平方根2倍，並非速度必然加倍。 兩個結果須按各自量綱解釋，不能直接相加或當成完整設計。均勻兩層與稀懸浮算例只呈現尺度，實際異重流受分層地形紊混與粒徑演變控制。 將先聲明分母範圍再核對進出砂積分與延後排出量作為獨立驗證，明確列出尚缺的現地輸入及其對結論的影響。
workedExample.textEn: Every input in this integrated example is a teaching assumption. First examine Suspension concentration and mixture density: rhoWater=1000 kg/m3; rhoSediment=2650 kg/m3; volumeFraction=0.01; rhoMix=(1-0.01)*1000+0.01*2650=1016.5 kg/m3. Independently examine Reduced gravity and buoyancy: g=9.81 m/s2; currentDensity=1016.5 kg/m3; ambientDensity=1000 kg/m3; reducedG=9.81*(1016.5-1000)/1000=0.161865 m/s2. Sensitivity: at fixed water and grain densities, raising volume concentration from0.005 to0.010 doubles density excess and reduced gravity. At fixed layer depth the gravity-velocity scale rises bysqrt(2), not by a factor of2. Interpret each result in its own dimensions rather than adding them or treating them as a complete design. Uniform two-layer dilute-suspension examples illustrate scales; real currents depend on stratification topography mixing and grain-size evolution. Use the following independent check: State the denominator scope and reconcile integrated arrival, export and delayed release. Identify missing field inputs and state which conclusions depend on them.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「懸浮濃度與混合密度」與「約化重力與浮力」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Suspension concentration and mixture density" and "Reduced gravity and buoyancy": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 懸浮濃度與混合密度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Suspension concentration and mixture density: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「懸浮濃度與混合密度」如何影響水庫異重流排砂的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Suspension concentration and mixture density” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Density-current venting for reservoir sediment”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 含砂水因顆粒增加體積平均密度而可能沿庫底前進，但鹽度與溫度分層也會改變背景密度。體積濃度不同於每立方公尺混合水的乾砂質量濃度，換算須使用顆粒密度；判斷下潛前應同步量測清水背景與含砂水。 驗證時應同步採樣顆粒濃度水溫與背景密度並核對濃度定義，並辨識以下失效情境：忽略冷暖水密度差會誤判含砂流的浮沉方向。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「懸浮濃度與混合密度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Suspended particles raise mixture density and can drive a bottom current, while temperature and salinity alter ambient density. Volume fraction differs from dry sediment mass per mixture volume and requires grain density for conversion. Measure both ambient and incoming water before inferring plunging behavior. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Measure sediment concentration, temperature and ambient density together and state concentration definitions. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Ignoring thermal density contrast can misidentify whether sediment-laden inflow rises or sinks. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Suspension concentration and mixture density” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：rhoWater=1000 kg/m3; rhoSediment=2650 kg/m3; volumeFraction=0.01; rhoMix=(1-0.01)*1000+0.01*2650=1016.5 kg/m3。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: rhoWater=1000 kg/m3; rhoSediment=2650 kg/m3; volumeFraction=0.01; rhoMix=(1-0.01)*1000+0.01*2650=1016.5 kg/m3.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要有泥砂就保證入流一定比任何庫水更重」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Any sediment load guarantees inflow denser than all reservoir water" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「懸浮濃度與混合密度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Suspension concentration and mixture density”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Suspension concentration and mixture density” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：rhoWater=1000 kg/m3; rhoSediment=2650 kg/m3; volumeFraction=0.01; rhoMix=(1-0.01)*1000+0.01*2650=1016.5 kg/m3。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: rhoWater=1000 kg/m3; rhoSediment=2650 kg/m3; volumeFraction=0.01; rhoMix=(1-0.01)*1000+0.01*2650=1016.5 kg/m3. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同步採樣顆粒濃度水溫與背景密度並核對濃度定義。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure sediment concentration, temperature and ambient density together and state concentration definitions.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 懸浮濃度與混合密度：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「懸浮濃度與混合密度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。

steps.instruction: 同步採樣顆粒濃度水溫與背景密度並核對濃度定義。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「忽略冷暖水密度差會誤判含砂流的浮沉方向」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.title: 密度福祿數與流態：機制與系統路徑

steps.instruction: 密度福祿數比較流速與層內重力波尺度，有助整理潛入與底流工況。流層厚度須由密度或濃度剖面定義，不能直接用水庫總深；真實前緣與非均勻分層不一定符合均勻兩層模型，需要以觀測檢查。 驗證時應用密度剖面界定流層厚度並量測流速與前緣位置，並辨識以下失效情境：把全庫深當流層厚度會低估密度福祿數。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「密度福祿數與流態」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Densimetric Froude number compares current speed with an internal gravity-wave scale. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Define layer depth from density profiles and measure speed and front position. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Using total reservoir depth as current thickness understates densimetric Froude number. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Densimetric Froude number and regime” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Front travel and timing window” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Density-current venting for reservoir sediment”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 底流前緣抵達壩前的時間受沿程坡度、捲吸及沉降改變，平均速度只提供第一輪時窗估算。它不是即時開門指令，實際需靠沿庫監測更新；應區分前緣速度與流層內平均速度，兩者不可直接互換。 驗證時應以多站濁度及密度到時比對前緣速度並更新抵達區間，並辨識以下失效情境：沿程速度改變會使固定時速外推偏離實際到達。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「前緣行程與時窗」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Front arrival depends on slope, entrainment and settling along the route. A mean-speed estimate supplies an initial time window rather than an operating command. Update it with distributed observations and distinguish front speed from mean velocity within the layer, which need not be equal. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Compare arrival times at multiple turbidity and density stations and update the arrival interval. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Changing speed along the route makes constant-speed arrival forecasts drift. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Front travel and timing window” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.title: 底孔捕捉與排出：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Low-outlet capture and export: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「底孔捕捉與排出」如何影響水庫異重流排砂的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Low-outlet capture and export” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Density-current venting for reservoir sediment”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 底孔能否捕捉異重流取決於流層高度、入口位置及抽取範圍，開門流量大不一定全部來自高濃度底層。排出濃度需由水樣量測，不能直接代入壩前最高濃度；應把清水摻入與捕捉效率分開。 驗證時應同步量測壩前垂向濃度與出口濃度並檢查抽取層位，並辨識以下失效情境：入口過高可能主要抽出清水而非底部高濃度流。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「底孔捕捉與排出」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Low-outlet capture depends on layer depth, inlet elevation and withdrawal geometry. A large release need not consist entirely of dense bottom water. Measure outlet concentration rather than substituting the maximum near-dam value, and distinguish clear-water dilution from capture efficiency. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Measure vertical concentration near the dam and at the outlet to identify withdrawal depth. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: A high inlet may withdraw mostly clear water instead of the dense bottom layer. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Low-outlet capture and export” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.title: 下游混合與溶氧：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「下游混合與溶氧」如何影響水庫異重流排砂的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Downstream mixing and dissolved oxygen” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Density-current venting for reservoir sediment”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 底層水可能具有不同溶氧與溫度，排砂成效不能只用移除砂量衡量。瞬時完全混合可估保守水質盤點，但曝氣、耗氧與化學反應會改變下游值；實際應觀測近場與遠場，不能把混合平均當各位置都達標。 驗證時應沿下游斷面量測溶氧與溫度並比較混合前後變化，並辨識以下失效情境：只量遠場平均會漏掉出口附近低氧帶。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「下游混合與溶氧」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Bottom water can differ in oxygen and temperature, so exported sediment is not the only outcome. Instantaneous complete mixing gives a bookkeeping estimate, while reaeration, demand and reactions alter downstream conditions. Observe near and far fields rather than treating the average as compliance everywhere. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Measure oxygen and temperature across downstream sections before and after mixing. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: A far-field average can miss a low-oxygen plume near the outlet. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Downstream mixing and dissolved oxygen” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：No reaction: releaseQ=10 m3/s atDO=2 mg/L; riverQ=30 m3/s atDO=8 mg/L; mixedDO=(10*2+30*8)/40=6.5 mg/L。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: No reaction: releaseQ=10 m3/s atDO=2 mg/L; riverQ=30 m3/s atDO=8 mg/L; mixedDO=(10*2+30*8)/40=6.5 mg/L.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「混合平均溶氧合適就代表所有下游位置相同」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "An acceptable mixed oxygen average means every downstream location is identical" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「下游混合與溶氧」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.instructionEn: A far-field average can miss a low-oxygen plume near the outlet. quiz.question: 在「底流質量帳與殘留」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Current mass budget and residual storage" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
將差額全部放在壩前會忽略沿庫分布沉積。
只要有泥砂就保證入流一定比任何庫水更重
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Assigning all residual sediment to the dam front ignores distributed deposition.
Any sediment load guarantees inflow denser than all reservoir water
quiz.explanation: 將差額全部放在壩前會忽略沿庫分布沉積。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Assigning all residual sediment to the dam front ignores distributed deposition. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
